record: provenance for the TI2026 post-event outcome archive

network_policy.scope: retrieval of completed TI2026 Main Event results only, after the tournament ended
network_policy.separation_from_production: The frozen 2026 production run recorded network_used=false, odds_used=false and future_main_event_results_used=false. Those fields describe the production run and remain true and unmodified. Network access here belongs to the archival phase and produced no input to any 2026 prediction.
excluded_by_policy: retrospective analyst opinion used as factual input

sources.type: first-party in-client capture (operator's logged-in Dota 2 client)
sources.scope: official in-client settlement of the operator's own 14 Main Event bracket selections: the aggregate 8/14 and a per-node correct/incorrect mark on every one of the 14 nodes

sources.retrieval_method: HTTPS GET via the MediaWiki parse API with a descriptive User-Agent
sources.scope: all 14 Main Event series: participants, map scores and scheduled start times
sources.note: the rendered page itself returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients; the parse API serves the same rendered bracket and is what was hashed

sources.scope: corroboration of all 14 Main Event series results and scores
sources.note: uses a different display-name convention ('1w Team', 'PARIVISION', 'BetBoom Team') than Liquipedia; both resolve through the repository's existing identity table

corroboration.series_results: 14 of 14 series agree between Liquipedia (tier 2) and egamersworld (tier 3) on participants, winner and exact map score
corroboration.node_winners: independently, all 14 winners agree with the tier-1 in-client settlement: the client's per-node correct/incorrect marks against the frozen submitted slate reproduce exactly under the retrieved winners
corroboration.champion: Team Spirit, agreed by all three sources

not_used.gosugamers-article: read during retrieval and NOT used as a data source: its summary rendered the series scores in a best-of-5 form (3-0, 3-2) that contradicts the verified best-of-3 format of every non-final Main Event series. The hashed sources above are authoritative here.
